title: CE AI Lab — Linux Host Overview

list.name: host
list.query:
from(bucket: "host_metrics")
  |> range(start: -1h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "cpu" and r._field == "usage_idle")
  |> group(columns: ["host"])
  |> distinct(column: "host")
  |> keep(columns: ["_value"])

targets.query:
from(bucket: "host_metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "cpu" and (r._field == "usage_idle") and r.host =~ /${host:regex}/)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: 100.0 - r._value }))
  |> group(columns: ["host", "cpu"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "cpu_pct")

from(bucket: "host_metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mem" and (r._field == "used_percent") and r.host =~ /${host:regex}/)
  |> group(columns: ["host"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "mem_pct")

from(bucket: "host_metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system" and (r._field == "load1" or r._field == "load5" or r._field == "load15") and r.host =~ /${host:regex}/)
  |> group(columns: ["host", "_field"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "load")

from(bucket: "host_metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mem" and (r._field == "used" or r._field == "available") and r.host =~ /${host:regex}/)
  |> group(columns: ["host", "_field"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "mem")

from(bucket: "host_metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "disk" and (r._field == "used_percent") and r.host =~ /${host:regex}/ and r.path !~ /^\/sys\//)
  |> group(columns: ["host", "path"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "disk_pct")

from(bucket: "host_metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "net" and (r._field == "bytes_recv" or r._field == "bytes_sent") and r.host =~ /${host:regex}/ and r.interface =~ /^(enp|ens|eth|eno|wlan|wlp)/)
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with dir: if r._field == "bytes_recv" then "RX" else "TX" }))
  |> group(columns: ["host", "interface", "dir"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "net")

from(bucket: "host_metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "diskio" and (r._field == "read_bytes" or r._field == "write_bytes") and r.host =~ /${host:regex}/ and r.name =~ /^(nvme[0-9]+n[0-9]+|sd[a-z]|vd[a-z])$/)
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with dir: if r._field == "read_bytes" then "Read" else "Write" }))
  |> group(columns: ["host", "name", "dir"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "diskio")

from(bucket: "host_metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "temp" and (r._field == "temp") and r.host =~ /${host:regex}/)
  |> group(columns: ["host", "sensor"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "temp")

from(bucket: "host_metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "processes" and (r._field == "total" or r._field == "zombies" or r._field == "sleeping") and r.host =~ /${host:regex}/)
  |> group(columns: ["host", "_field"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "proc")
